svg.title: Food-ordering system: baseline control structure
svg.desc: Above the ordering-system boundary, comparison collection supplies recorded food pairs and customer choices (x, z, y) to model fitting and evaluation. Fitted parameters are installed in the preference predictor; installation is not a per-order command. Inside the boundary, the available food pair (x, z) enters the predictor. The ordering controller encloses the predictor and ordering rule. The predicted choice enters the rule, which submits orders or requests cancellation from the merchant order-and-charge process. The merchant returns received, committed, or cancelled status. The rule notifies the customer, who can request correction or cancellation. In the baseline, notification and correction need not occur before commitment. Gray arrows denote data or installation, black arrows control actions, and blue arrows status, notification, or customer feedback. No pre-purchase confirmation is present.
